# Test empty notification lists according to each field’s semantics

The tests intentionally accept null or [] for displayed_notifications, while [] rejects locale, version, channel and operating-system membership filters. The history predicate’s some check means an empty prerequisite list has no failing prerequisite. Preserve these separate cases when extending this filter; do not derive one universal empty-array policy from the shared profile shape. The formatter follow-up is retained as source context, not a new manual layout rule. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or live accessibility validation was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: Notification profile empty-value tests.
